name: resume-tailor
description: Tailor a resume + matching cover letter to a specific role from your real evidence. Honesty-graded (every claim carries its evidence and a verifiability grade), falsifier-gated (refuses to state what it can't defend), voice-tuned from your own LinkedIn writing, and register-fit to the hiring manager. Surfaces an orthogonal-echo proof point (a shipped artifact of yours that independently solves the target's product problem), leads with strengths for the JD, renders print-safe with an ATS-plain companion, and runs an adversarial pre-send gauntlet.
